content: Automatic Data Collection. We may collect certain information automatically when you use our Services, such as your device identifier, Internet protocol (IP) address, mobile advertising identifier (e.g., Google Advertising ID “GAID”, IDFA), push tokens, browser user-agent, device information (including device type, screen size, operating system, language setting and time zone)), and Network provider when utilizing our Service. We may also automatically collect information regarding your use of our Services, such as links you click, the types of content you interact with, including video streams you watch, content you follow or like, products you view, the frequency and duration of your activities, ads presented on your device, including, content type of the ad (the advertiser and category, e.g., games, finance, entertainment, news); ad type (e.g., whether the ad is a text, image, video or other format based); where the ad is being served (e.g., the site, digital media or app on which the ad appears); whether you viewed, clicked or otherwise interacted with the ad, and other information about how you use our Services.
